info.title: PathFinder AI API
info.description:
AI-powered student interest discovery, skill development and personal growth platform.

**Response format** - success responses return the resource (or a page `{items,total,page,page_size}`); errors always return `{error: {code, message, details, request_id}}`.

**Auth** - `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Web clients refresh through an httpOnly cookie; mobile clients send `refresh_token` in the body.
